_method: Two INDEPENDENT axes decide whether a hull's interior may become a def.
AXIS A - interior-rig pin. The sidecar's derivedFromRigSha256 must be the LF sha256 of the
boatInteriorRig.js actually shipped in the kit. A pin naming a renderer that is not in the
drop cannot be checked against anything, so it is refused (the sidecar-hash law: an
unverifiable pin is a refusal, exactly as an absent one is).
AXIS B - hull baseline. The interior was measured against SOME version of the exterior hull
rig. Establish it (the gameplay sidecar's _supersedes where sane, else by hashing every
version of that rig in the repo's whole history), then diff main's current rig against it
and classify every hunk as loft/house/door geometry or not. Geometry that MOVED is fatal;
paint, materials, cues and comments are not.
A hull needs BOTH axes to pass. All hashes are LF-normalised sha256 (tr -d '\r' | sha256sum).

hulls.evidence: VERIFIED by diff, both directions. Main's capeIslanderIsoRig.js (92c3061b, 33162 B) publishes NO loft, NO HOUSE, NO halfAtZ, NO sheerZ (grep count 0 for each) and carries #247's washboard clamp plus #508's OKLCH paint (9 refs). The kit's (a3be1d61, 28482 B) publishes all four (3/6/2/2 refs), carries the real aft DOOR, and has NO paint (0 refs) and NO #247 clamp. Every input the room is measured from is identical across both: L=12.8, TH=0.05, DECK=0.72, NSEG=24, ROOFZ=3.02, SOLE_U=0.74, HX=1.32, HY0=0.5, HY1=2.9, HZ1=2.98, FYb=2.54, FYt=3.10 (same values; the kit hoists FYb/FYt to module scope so HOUSE can read them), and station(), skin(), dfrac(), dw() verbatim. HOUSE is built only from those; halfAtZ/sheerZ only from station() and L. WB is absent from the published loft. So the rooms are SOUND -- the refusal is not about the measurement, it is that neither rig file can be adopted whole.

_corrections: 2026-08-19, capeIslanderIsoRig: STALE-FATAL -> FORKED-RIG. The original verdict's OBSERVATION was
right (main's rig carries #247's washboard clamp; the kit's carries the pre-#247 line verbatim)
but the INFERENCE from it was wrong twice over, and upstream caught both.
(a) The washboards are not measured geometry for the interior. The kit rig publishes
loft:{station, skin, dfrac, halfAtZ, sheerZ, L, TH, DECK, SOLE_U, NSEG, house:HOUSE, shade,
cell} and WB appears ONLY inside the washboard face-emission loop (lines 191/197/198), never
in the published loft. #247 moved exterior deck surface the interior rig cannot read.
(b) 'Re-measure against main's current rig' was not merely unnecessary, it was impossible:
main's rig publishes no loft and no HOUSE at all, and boatInteriorRig.js line 268 reads
'if(!E || !E.loft) return null;' with list() filtering on that. Adopting main's rig as the
hull rig would DELETE the cape from the kit rather than re-measure her.
The two files are not stale-vs-current, they are two 'pass 2' FORKS that never merged: main =
OKLCH paint (#508) + #247 washboards, no loft/HOUSE; kit = the real aft DOOR + published loft,
